tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background (cream). Default ground for everything.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and dialogs above surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Set-apart areas: filter bars, footer, icon backgrounds.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (≥ 12:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: delivery time, metadata, help text. ≥ 5.9:1 on every surface token.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers. Not for form field borders (too little contrast).

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of input fields, checkboxes and secondary buttons (≥ 3:1).

tokens.name: brand-berry
tokens.usage: Logo face and illustrations. NEVER a text colour or a background for small text: cream on it is only 4.3:1.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, active tabs, count badges such as the basket count. Exactly one primary action per screen.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on action (5.2:1 light, 5.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Text links on surface and surface-raised (≥ 5.4:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 3 px wide with a 2 px offset from the element.

tokens.name: cheese
tokens.usage: Highlight: offer badges, new markers, stars. Text on it is always on-cheese.

tokens.name: on-cheese
tokens.usage: Text on cheese, in both themes (10:1).

tokens.name: crust
tokens.usage: Illustration only (pizza crust, crumbs). No UI use.

tokens.name: pepperoni
tokens.usage: Illustration only (pepperoni). Use error for errors.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text and error borders, always with an icon and text, never colour alone.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations: order accepted, rider on the way.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing page hero, at most one line per screen.

styles.name: heading-s
styles.usage: Restaurant names on cards, dialog titles.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Wir bringen dir dein Lieblingsessen – heiß und pünktlich.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata in ink-muted. Never smaller than 13 px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between badges, tight lists.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of chips and small buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, mobile page margin.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page margin.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Input fields, badges.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Cards, images, sheets, app icon (24 on 100).

tokens.name: radius-mark
tokens.usage: Logo face only (rx 30 on 92). Not for UI.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Filter pills, quantity stepper.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards above surface. The only shadow level.
